name: pdfcraft-mcp-server
description: Read, split, merge, organize, watermark, protect, redact, fill, sign, convert, compress and OCR PDFs with the PdfCraft editor installed on Windows, macOS or Linux. Not affiliated with PdfCraft or Storytold.
long_description:
PdfCraft Bridge lets Claude work on PDFs with the PdfCraft you already have installed on Windows, macOS or Linux (tested with 0.4.0), the open-source, Acrobat-class editor written in Rust.

- **Read**: document info, page sizes, fonts, security, signatures; text by page; pages as PNG / JPEG / TIFF.
- **Pages**: split (every N pages, before pages, by bookmarks or size), merge with page ranges, extract, insert, duplicate, rotate, move, delete, crop, page labels, metadata.
- **Add**: text and picture watermarks, headers and footers with page numbers and Bates numbers, backgrounds, text boxes, images, links.
- **Secure**: passwords and permissions (AES-256), true redaction of words, patterns (email, phone, SSN, card, dates) and areas, hidden-information removal, digital signatures.
- **Forms**: list, auto-detect, fill and flatten.
- **Convert**: Word, HTML, RTF, text, images, PDF/A; create PDFs from images or text; reduce file size; OCR; compare versions.
- **Everything else**: run any of PdfCraft's 131 engine tools (comments, bookmarks, accessibility, measurements, JavaScript...).

The connector drives PdfCraft's own headless engine (pdfcraft-cli). Everything runs locally with no network access; files are never overwritten unless you ask. PdfCraft is an open-source project by Storytold; this connector is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

pdfcraft_dir.title: PdfCraft folder
pdfcraft_dir.description: Install folder of PdfCraft (or PdfCraft.app on macOS). Leave empty to auto-detect: C:\Program Files\PdfCraft, /Applications/PdfCraft.app, /usr/bin, /opt/pdfcraft or PATH.

pdfcraft_cli.title: pdfcraft-cli executable (optional)
pdfcraft_cli.description: Only if it is somewhere else, e.g. where you unzipped pdfcraft-cli-<version>-macos-universal.zip on macOS.

pdfcraft_root.title: Limit access to this folder (optional)
pdfcraft_root.description: When set, PdfCraft may only read and write files inside this folder.
